A '''fire rod''' was a hollow 10 centimeter plastic tube divided into 2 chambers. Each chamber held an inert chemical that would quickly ignite when combine with the other. A fire rod could be used as a sole source of heat and light, or applied to other combustible material to keep the fire burning longer.
